title: Vistula 1920: The Cipher That Stopped a Revolution
summary: Recounts how the Red Army under Tukhachevsky reached the gates of Warsaw in the summer of nineteen twenty, and how Poland reversed the front with the counterattack launched from the Wieprz River on the sixteenth of August, backed by the advantage a mathematician officer had won by breaking Soviet radio ciphers. The episode ranges from the collapse of the plan to carry the revolution into Germany to the Treaty of Riga, and to the bitter legacy the victory left twenty years later.
